config system interface
    edit "x1"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 10.1.1.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh "http"
        config ipv6
            set ip6-mode static
        end
    next
    edit "wan1"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode dhcp
        set allowaccess "http"
    next
end
